encounter.notes: Six-legged crab/arachnid. A dark spined SHELL sits high and to the rear; the pale fleshy body and the fanged mouth hang UNDERNEATH and FORWARD of it at mid height, with two yellow eye nodules on the shell. Not a biped: no height threshold selects the head, because the top of the silhouette is shell. Highest encounter-slot count of any single trash name (4x in Cloudrest).

reference.closeup_policy: Deliberately none - 512px trash profile; the base plates carry a 980/986px subject and already oversample the atlas ~2x.
reference.orientation_verified: 2026-09-07, and this set does NOT follow the gallery convention. view-01 is a 3/4 front, rotated maybe 20 degrees off-axis (mouth off-centre, near-side legs foreshortened). view-02 is the true head-on orthographic front: legs symmetric left and right, mouth centred, shell centred behind. view-03 is the matching orthographic back. The survey's manifest measured view-01 as the front (1156x985); the pair actually used here is view-02 (1221x980) / view-03 (1251x986). Checked side by side in _advice-crops/y-set.jpg. This is exactly the failure the 'verify by eye' rule exists for - every metric would have looked fine on the 3/4 plate.

geometry.provenance: Tencent Hunyuan3D-2mv (fp16, 50 steps, octree 380, seed 12345) from build/yaghra-monstrosity/plates/{front,back}-geometry.png (1628x1628, letterboxed because the leg span is wider than the subject is tall). Draft: 719,108 faces in 68.7s on an RTX 4070 Ti Super. TRASH budget 5,000 target / 6,000 max.

uv_density.note: UNIFORM unwrap, no density warp and no region boxes, deliberately. The scalar head_v_min band is meaningless here - the top of this silhouette is shell, and the fanged face hangs below and forward of it, so no height threshold selects it. A region box could select it, but the standing rule is that a box must be verified on a membership render first, and on this subject the payoff does not justify it: the face is a single large pale mass covering roughly a quarter of the frontal area, so a uniform unwrap already gives it a large share of a 512 atlas. Revisit with a verified box only if this is ever promoted to the 1024 boss profile.
